property_summary: For any caller that is the contract owner and any input address, calling updateAlloSettings(newAlloSettings) sets c.alloSettings() equal to the provided newAlloSettings; the mutant instead always sets alloSettings to the zero address, breaking this property for inputs where newAlloSettings != address(0).
change_summary: Change updateAlloSettings to update alloSettings with the zero address instead of the provided newAlloSettings.
